## Projects

- [Mycelium](https://mycelium-labs.github.io/mycelium/): Open-source reliability runtime for consequential AI-agent tool calls. Durable transition envelopes return stored results, poll in-flight work, reconcile provider state, or fail closed under ambiguous mutating retries. Supports LangGraph, CrewAI, and custom Python loops with file, SQLite, Redis, and PostgreSQL ledgers. Its 800+ test verification posture covers process crashes, multi-worker races, storage outages, and reconciliation. SDK: mycelium-runtime on PyPI (v1.31.0). Source: https://github.com/mycelium-labs/mycelium · Stats: https://pepy.tech/projects/mycelium-runtime
- Meridian: JLR Global Techathon 2026 winning hiring-automation platform. Converts job descriptions into skill-ontology graphs, overlays resumes with evidence-grounded present/partial/gap analysis, and generates adaptive assessments using topic-tree routing, Rasch ability estimation, and deduplicated question banks
- [KAIROS / Auto-Agent](https://github.com/nandanadileep/auto-agent): Autonomous background coding agent with presence-aware notifications and nightly memory consolidation
- [vLLM-style LLM Serving on Apple Silicon](https://github.com/nandanadileep/vllm-like-llm-serving): MLX inference engine with PagedAttention-inspired KV cache, continuous batching, OpenAI-compatible chat completions
- [Identiti](https://identiti.nandanadileep.com): Personal AI memory layer using Neo4j knowledge graphs. Source: https://github.com/nandanadileep/aegis

## Work

- JLR Technology & Business Services India (2024–present): Core developer on Sarvam, an AI-native Everything-as-Code platform for automotive requirements, HLD/LLD, tests, and compliance; ML systems for test-rig optimization (18% cost reduction on 500K+ daily telemetry events)
- Amazon (Summer 2023): SWE Intern — Alexa latency-analysis service on AWS Lambda, Coral, and OpenSearch
